macos.notes: One item per token rotation under the same service; read the newest by modification date. A profile at ~/.claude-<slug> files its token under 'Claude Code-credentials-<first 8 hex of sha256(path)>'. Read the item's attributes to know whether it changed before reading its data, so the keychain prompt appears once per token.

windows.notes: Profiles: every ~/.claude-<slug> directory containing sessions/, projects/, settings.json, history.jsonl or .claude.json is an account of its own with its own .credentials.json.

endpoints.name: usage
endpoints.notes: The same endpoint Claude Code's /usage command uses. 401/403 once: drop the cached token, re-read it and retry a single time. 429 answers Retry-After: 0, which must be treated as a floor-raiser only.

windows.label: Current session
windows.notes: Also present as $.five_hour.utilization; merge it in when limits[] lacks the session, which happens the moment a window rolls over.

windows.label: {scope.model.display_name}
windows.notes: Seen live 2026-09-07 on a Team plan: a per-model weekly limit whose label is the model's display name.

sessions.notes: One file per running process: pid, cwd, name, entrypoint (cli | claude-vscode | claude-desktop | local-agent), status (busy | waiting | idle) or tempo (active | blocked), statusUpdatedAt/updatedAt in epoch millis, startedAt in epoch millis, procStart as a UTC ctime string, waitingFor/needs. Trust the file only while the pid is alive and its start time is within 5 minutes of startedAt.

status.notice: Reads the token Claude Code stores; never refreshes or writes it.
